stories.title: Alcaraz Wins Paris Masters — Five Titles in 2026, First Paris Crown

x_posts.label: Post 1-1
x_posts.text:
Carlos Alcaraz is the 2026 Paris Masters champion.

Beats Shelton 7-6(5), 7-5. Five titles in 2026. Nine Masters 1000 crowns. First Paris title ever.

The best player in tennis right now. #TennisFanrecap #ParisMasters

x_posts.label: Post 1-2
x_posts.text:
Alcaraz at the 2026 US Open: lost in the QF to Shelton (5 sets).

Alcaraz at the 2026 Paris Masters: beat Shelton in the final.

Fifth title. First Paris crown. That's the comeback story of the year. #TennisFanrecap #Alcaraz

Rybakina is OUT of the WTA Finals.

The world No. 1 withdrew for medical reasons before her first match. Kostyuk replaced her.

Day 1: Gauff d. Pegula 6-4, 6-7(5), 6-2. Noskova d. Kostyuk 6-2, 6-4.

#TennisFanrecap #WTAFinals

x_posts.label: Post 2-2
x_posts.text:
WTA Finals Day 2 at Indian Wells:

Sabalenka d. Muchova 7-6(2), 7-5.
Andreeva d. Svitolina 6-4, 6-0.

Andreeva won the final SEVEN games of the match. She looks unstoppable. #TennisFanrecap #WTAFinals

Alcaraz arrives having won Vienna AND Paris back-to-back. Can Zverev, Shelton or Medvedev stop him?

Rafael Jodar — first player in ATP history to qualify in his debut year on tour.

This field has everything. #TennisFanrecap #ATPFinals

stories.title: Van Assche's Paris Fairy Tale Ends in SF, But the Future Is Bright

x_posts.label: Post 4
x_posts.text:
Shelton d. Van Assche 5-7, 6-3, 6-4 to reach the Paris final.

Van Assche's wildcard run is over — but what a run. Beat a Top 15 seed. Beat the man who beat the world No. 1. Reached the home SF at 21.

French tennis, take notes. #TennisFanrecap #ParisMasters
